comment: Hand-picked inputs to build.py. Everything else in wiki-data.js comes from the ZIM.
pool_comment: Not Weapons: on the wiki that holds only weapons from Minecraft: The Manga, while the game's weapons are in Items.
pool_exclude_comment: Pool articles in these are left out of the pool: book and comic objects, April Fools features, and things a player can't find in the current game. Chaos still rolls them.
hubs_comment: No hubs rule: links to these and their redirects are dead. Picked from the pages with the most incoming and outgoing links (report.py lists candidates), leaving out specific content (Diamond, Chest, Water…) that makes a fair target.
namespaces_comment: The ZIM holds articles and categories plus the wiki's own content namespaces (Tutorial, Dungeons…), and build.py adds those and their talk namespaces. Links into these other namespaces still appear on live pages, so they are listed by hand (from meta=siteinfo).
